_meta.machine: Intel Core i7-1255U, 15.7GB RAM, Windows 11, JDK 25.0.3+9, Maven 3.9.15
_meta.tolerance_rationale: Phase 2 02-BASELINE-AFTER.md documented sum_reduce CI ±9.575ms on a 10.33ms score (±93%); multiply 10^7 CI ±555ms on 69.73ms (±796%). Hybrid P/E-core variance is the noise floor. Original D-12 tolerance of 15% does not survive contact with the actual machine. Bumped to 50% — gate still catches >2x regressions which is the realistic detection floor for serious performance regressions (e.g. someone added a serial loop, doubled the work, broke the threshold gate).
_meta.future_work: Phase 5 may pin to P-cores via /affinity or set up isolated benchmark profile. Until then, treat ±50% as the noise floor on this hardware.
